svg.title: Spolvero: how a drawing reaches the wall
svg.desc: A cartoon of the tree pricked along its lines with a needle; a bag of charcoal dust patted over the pricked sheet; and the dotted drawing left on fresh plaster, where a painter has begun to paint along the dots.
svg.text: the drawing, pricked along its lines
patted with a bag of charcoal dust
dots on fresh plaster, to paint by
